verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents fine-grained RBAC over its resources, including restricting who can modify production environments. It also exposes an Admin API, reachable by agents through its MCP server, and per-environment client keys that are public and non-secret. However, nothing in the evidence shows that RBAC scopes can be attached to API or Admin API credentials issued to an agent, so least-privilege agent credentials are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit scoped/role-bound Admin API keys, documentation tying MCP or agent credentials to RBAC permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
